ftbquests.barrier.teleport.dimension.too: Leave empty for teleportation in the current dimension
ftbquests.barrier.teleport.pitch.tooltip: Positive values look down, negative values look up
ftbquests.barrier.teleport.relative.tool: When true, destination is relative to Barrier block position
ftbquests.changelog.show_time.tooltip: Time to keep change history shown if "Always Show Change History" is false
ftbquests.chapter.appearance.default_pre: Visual preset to be used by all quests in this chapter which don't override it
ftbquests.click_action_type.open_quest.t: Provide a quest ID, which can be obtained via the Copy ID context menu action
ftbquests.click_action_type.open_uri.too: Can be used to open http/https/file URLs
ftbquests.file.defaults.default_preset.t: Visual preset to be used by all chapters and quests which don't override it
ftbquests.file.suppress_all_autoclaiming:
If true, no rewards can be autoclaimed, including via the "Claim All" button on the reward selector screen
May be useful during pack development to ensure testers read quests...
ftbquests.gui.error.already_component: Line is already text component JSON!
ftbquests.gui.kr.drag_highlight: Middle Mouse: Drag;Select Quests in Drag Box
ftbquests.gui.kr.drag_toggle_select: Ctrl + Middle Mouse: Drag;Toggle selection in Drag Box
ftbquests.image.click_action_data.toolti:
• Open URI: a http://, https:// or file:/// URL
• Jump to a Quest: a quest ID - use 'Copy Quest ID' context menu entry
• Run a Command: command to run on the server
• Post Custom Event: ID argument (namespace:path) for CustomClickEvent listeners
• Show Recipes for Item: item ID
• Show a Docs Page: <mod>,<book-id>[,<page-id>[,<anchor>]]
ftbquests.image.position_locked.tooltip:
If true, prevents the image from being moved
Useful to prevent accidental movement when other objects overlap
ftbquests.image.text.text_inset.tooltip: Horizontal & vertical insets as percentage of image width & height, respectively
ftbquests.image.text.text_on_image.toolt:
If true, title text (if any) is drawn directly on image
If false, title text is used a tooltip
ftbquests.pinned.pinned_exclude_flexible:
If true, quests which are only startable due to flexible mode (so not completable yet) are not shown in the tracker
If false, all startable quests are shown
ftbquests.quest.appearance.preset.toolti:
Visual preset to be used by this quest
If empty, also checks for chapter and file defaults
If non-empty, overrides the "Shape" and "Size" settings for this quest
ftbquests.quest.misc.repeat_cooldown.too:
Only applies if 'Repeatable Quest' is true.
The delay in seconds between claiming all the rewards for the quest and being able to redo the quest's tasks.
ftbquests.task.ftbquests.gamestage.team_:
Per-team game stages instead of per-player
Can be granted via Stage Reward with Team Reward enabled,
or via '/ftbteams teamstage ...' command
or via FTB Teams API
ftbquests.task.ftbquests.kill.nbt_filter:
If non-empty, fuzzy match against the entity's NBT
Use standard Minecraft SNBT syntax here
e.g. {Color: 4b} matches a yellow-dyed sheep
ftbquests.task.ftbquests.observation.to_:
ID of the block, block entity, or entity to observe, or a block or entity tag
For block entities and entities, NBT may be optionally appended for a fuzzy match, e.g.
minecraft:sheep{Color: 4b} - a yellow sheep
Important: NBT to be matched must be sync'd to the client by the server-side entity!
